subject: Pilot extension options — convert remaining days to burst credits vs short extension
messages:
From: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@oaklinehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@oaklinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot days remaining and extension options

Hi Jordan,

Quick one — our team ran the Redwood pilot over the last 3 weeks and we still have about 8 unused evaluation days in the window. We hit some onboarding delays (data ingest) and would like to understand the lightweight options to avoid losing progress:

- Convert the 8 unused days into burst credits (token-based) we can consume over the next 30 days?
- Or extend the pilot by 14–21 days with the same access/engine parameters?

Budget is tight — procurement asked if there's a small fee for the extension or whether credits are the cleaner option. Also curious if engineering support (1:1) is available during a short extension.

Can you outline pricing and next steps? If you prefer, loop in finance/legal for a quick amendment.

Thanks,
Ayesha Rahman
Director of AI Platforms | Oakline Health

--
Oakline Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0193
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@oaklinehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot days remaining and extension options

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the context, and glad the pilot generated useful signals despite the ingest delays. We can do either path; below are two practical, short options and the economics so procurement can pick: 

Option A — Convert unused days to burst credits (recommended if you expect irregular spikes):
- Convert 8 unused days into a one-time bucket of burst credits equivalent to ~120 compute-hours at your pilot profile.
- Price: $3,200 one-time credit (covers model + infra) — usable for 30 days.
- Pros: no contract amendment, immediate availability, consumes down tokens.
- Cons: capped 30-day expiry, no SLA change.

Option B — Time extension (14 or 21 days):
- 14-day extension: $2,100 flat fee (keeps the same pilot config and retention).
- 21-day extension: $2,900 flat fee.
- Pros: keeps continuity, preserves pilot telemetry in current window.
- Cons: requires a brief addendum/PO sign-off (we can shortcut with a DocuSign amendment).

Engineering support: We can include one 2-hour onboarding session with an SRE/solutions engineer during either path at no additional charge for the extension. If you want ongoing daily check-ins, we can scope that separately.

Attached: brief proposal PDF and a usage export so you can see the burn pattern (pilot_usage_report.csv). If procurement wants to route via PO, Kimberly is on copy to confirm the commercial flow.

Next steps I suggest: you confirm preferred option and whether procurement needs an addendum/PO. If you want, I can pull DocuSign and route to your procurement contact for signature.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 650-555-0137

Attachments:
- proposal_oakline_extension_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)
- pilot_usage_report.csv (text/csv, 12KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@oaklinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot days remaining and extension options

Ayesha — quick note from finance/legal side: both Option A and Option B are fine. A few clarifications to help procurement pick a path: 

- For Option A (burst credits): we'll issue an invoice for the one-time $3,200 credit. Credits expire 30 days after issue; credits are non-refundable but transferable within Oakline (same org).
- For Option B (time extension): we need a signed addendum that references your original PO and confirms the new end-date. Addendum turnaround is typically <48 hours once signed.

If Oakline prefers minimal paperwork, Option A avoids an addendum. If they need the pilot window extended for audit/validation traces, take Option B.

I'll prepare a short addendum template and a DocuSign envelope if Jordan confirms procurement wants the amendment. Also confirming the included 2-hour engineering session is covered for both options.

—Kimberly Park
Sr. Commercial Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@oaklinehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot days remaining and extension options

Hi Ayesha — quick ops note from our side:

- We reviewed your usage export and can confirm the 8 unused days map to ~110 test-token-hours with the current model (the small variance is due to session warmups).
- If you pick Option A (credits) we'll provision the bucket within 2 business hours after payment is processed and share a short how-to for redeeming burst credits in the Console.
- If you pick Option B (time extension) we'll keep the same model pins and telemetry windows; please confirm if you need additional log retention beyond the current window (we can extend retention for an extra $200).

Also happy to schedule the 2-hour onboarding slot for next week — propose Wed 7/7 10:00–12:00 PDT. Let me know if that works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@oaklinehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot days remaining and extension options

Thanks all — procurement discussed both and prefers the burst-credit route to avoid amending our PO. We will proceed with Option A and the $3,200 one-time credit. Please send invoice and DocuSign/ payment instructions; we also want the 2-hour onboarding session on Wed 7/7 10:00–12:00 PDT.
